Description
The University of Surrey is located in the attractive city of Guildford, just south of London. It has consistently been in the top 60 of the three main ranking compilations of UK universities. 
Once students complete the foundation program with the required grades, they can start their degree at the University of Surrey with the skills needed to succeed.
